Use Case: Prepare customer refunds from support requests
Autonomy Rationale: Prepares refund actions but requires approval before execution
Data Sensitivity Rationale: Customer data and order history are in scope
Human Oversight Design: Supervisor approval required above defined thresholds
Business Impact Rationale: Incorrect refunds or denials create customer, financial, and compliance impact
Required Controls: Least privilege refund API scope; approval workflow; prompt-injection tests; audit logging; monitoring; incident route
Approval Points: Supervisor approval before refund API call
Logging Evidence: Trace includes request, policy, proposed decision, approval, tool call, final result
Reassessment Trigger: Prompt, tool, policy, data source, approval threshold, or launch-scope change
